You can ask for a State Hearing by calling: 1-800-
743-8525. TDD users, call 1-800-952-8349. You can
also request a hearing in the following ways:
• You can request a hearing ONLINE at
WWW.CDSS.CA.GOV
• You can fill out this form and FAX it to State
Hearings toll-free at 1-833-281-0903
• You can fill out this form and EMAIL it to
SCOPEOFBENEFITS@DSS.CA.GOV
• (Note: If you send it by email, please
understand there is a risk that someone other
than the State Hearings Division could intercept
your email.  Please consider using a more
secure method of sending your request.)
